name: Correct one error without discouraging practice
short_description: Correct one error without discouraging practice once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can correct one error without discouraging practice in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Correct one error without discouraging practice means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Correct one error without discouraging practice in a fresh real-life scenario.
